def return_book(self, loan_id: int = None) -> models.Loan:
        loan = self._repos['LoanRepository'].read_one_loan(loan_id)
        if loan is None:
            raise errors.LoanNotFoundError("Loan not found")

        if loan.return_date is not None:
            raise errors.InvalidReturnDateError("Loan already returned")

        loan.return_date = datetime.datetime.now()
        loan.status = "returned"

        updated_loan = self._repos['LoanRepository'].update_loan(loan_id, loan)

        book = self._repos['BookRepository'].read_one_book(loan.book_id)
        if book is None:
            raise errors.BookNotFoundError("Book not found")

        book.available_copies += 1
        updated_book = self._repos['BookRepository'].update_book(loan.book_id, book)

        return updated_loan

def borrow_book(self, member_id: int = None, book_id: int = None) -> models.Loan:
        """Borrow a book by member and book IDs, checks availability, creates loan, and decrements copies."""
        member = self._repos['MemberRepository'].read_one_member(member_id)
        if member is None:
            raise errors.MemberNotFoundError("Member not found")

        book = self._repos['BookRepository'].read_one_book(book_id)
        if book is None:
            raise errors.BookNotFoundError("Book not found")

        if book.available_copies <= 0:
            raise errors.InsufficientCopiesError("Not enough copies available")

        loan = models.Loan(
            book_id=book_id,
            member_id=member_id,
            loan_date=datetime.datetime.now(),
            due_date=datetime.datetime.now() + datetime.timedelta(days=14),
            status="active"
        )

        updated_book = self._repos['BookRepository'].update_book(book_id, book=book.copy(update={"available_copies": book.available_copies - 1}))
        updated_loan = self._repos['LoanRepository'].create_loan(loan=loan)

        return updated_loan
